lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 2 fix 002: address reviewer finding

openQuestions: US-R2-003 is BLOCKED again on a second consecutive implementer dispatch; nothing in the repo changed between the two dispatches (verified this session: scripts/cam/prd.json still has 8 occurrences of the literal string 'oracle: named-command', at lines 61, 62, 78, 81, 100, 102 -- the same 6 acceptanceCriteria strings named below -- plus the 2 narrative occurrences inside the story's own notes/text fields). The finding (scripts/cam/prd.json:32) is that 6 of this PRD's 25 oracle directives embed a literal 'named-command ' prefix that classifyOracleText (src/supervisor/behavioral-gate.ts:108-125) does not strip, so runBehavioralGate ships `named-command bash -c '...'`/`named-command bun test ...` to the shell and gets exit 127 every time; the reviewer's independent Layer B run confirmed 10 PASS / 6 FAIL(127). The mechanical fix is dropping the literal 'named-command ' prefix from those 6 acceptanceCriteria strings in scripts/cam/prd.json, which no implementer session can make: CAM_WORKER=1 and CAM_SESSION are both set (verified via `env` this session), and .claude/hooks/orch-agent-allowlist.sh denies Write/Edit/MultiEdit against any path matching *scripts/cam/prd.json whenever CAM_WORKER=1, unconditionally of what the edit changes (re-read the hook source this session at lines 83-107 to confirm the deny is unconditional, not content-sensitive). scripts/cam/patterns.md:942 already documents that routing around the tool-level guard via a raw Bash write (the hook only matches Write/Edit/MultiEdit tool names, not Bash) is not an available escape hatch: it would let a worker self-grade its own acceptance criteria unreviewed. This is the identical CAM-433/CAM-434 dead-end class (patterns.md:1064-1066), whose explicit rule is: do not keep re-dispatching implementer retries once the dead end is documented once; escalate to an orchestrator/operator (non-CAM_WORKER) session instead. Exact edits needed, all in scripts/cam/prd.json under userStories[]: US-001 acceptanceCriteria[2] (AC3, line 61) and [3] (AC4, line 62); US-002 acceptanceCriteria[1] (AC2, line 78) and [4] (AC5, line 81); US-003 acceptanceCriteria[4] (AC5, line 100) and [6] (AC7, line 102) -- in each of these 6 strings, replace the substring `[oracle: named-command ` with `[oracle: ` (the trailing `]` and the command text inside are unchanged; only the 'named-command ' token is dropped, e.g. AC3 becomes `... [oracle: bash -c '! grep -q "config.toml with permission_mode" index.ts && grep -q "retry.toml" index.ts']`). Re-running each of the 6 directives without the prefix exits 0 per the reviewer's SECTION 2 hand-verification cited in the story notes.

US-R2-003's own notes flag a second, distinct product/doc mismatch that is explicitly out of scope for this PR (the story notes say it 'belongs in a separate issue'): templates/commands/cam-issue.md:132 and the implementer/reviewer agent contracts display the '[oracle: named-command ...]' prefixed form as the documented spec, while templates/agents/subagent-planner.md:158 and the parser (classifyOracleText) expect the bare command -- so a planner following the documented form will keep emitting unrunnable directives. Not touched by this story; needs its own filed issue.
nextStoryContext: US-R2-003 could not implement the fix on this (second) dispatch either, for the identical reason as the prior dispatch: the reviewer finding names 6 oracle-text defects in scripts/cam/prd.json whose only correct resolution is a mechanical string edit to prd.json's own acceptanceCriteria strings (dropping a literal 'named-command ' prefix), and prd.json is hard-blocked from Write/Edit/MultiEdit for every CAM_WORKER=1 implementer session (.claude/hooks/orch-agent-allowlist.sh, re-verified this session). No source, template, or binary was touched. Baseline health re-verified as a sanity check only (not tied to this finding): `bun run typecheck` 0 errors, full `bun test` 5760 pass / 0 fail (same count as the prior story's handoff, confirming no regression across the idle interval). This story is left passes:false; see openQuestions for the exact orchestrator/operator prd.json edits needed to unblock it (mirrors the CAM-433/CAM-434 dead-end class already documented at scripts/cam/patterns.md:1064-1066). Per that precedent's explicit rule, do NOT keep dispatching further implementer retries of US-R2-003 -- the fix requires an orchestrator/operator (non-CAM_WORKER) session to edit scripts/cam/prd.json directly, exactly as CAM-434's line-1066 resolution bullet describes; a third implementer retry would just reproduce this identical blocked outcome (and, per the CAM-214 circuit-breaker pattern already in this codebase, N=3 consecutive identical BLOCKED_* outcomes on an unchanged PRD is the harness's own signal to halt auto-dispatch on this story).
